assumptions.md, spec.md, requirements.yaml, plan.yaml, question and answer files; 1 ingestion per (path, sha256)IdeaFolderIngest

svg.text: Plan invariant: I3: every requirement of an idea in in_progress or later is covered by at least 1 task that is not cancelled.
Plan invariant: A plan is committed all-or-nothing after every validator check passes (FR-3, FR-4).
Plan invariant: A judgment-kind task without a paired judge refuses the plan.
Plan invariant: The task dependencies of a plan form a graph with no cycle (FR-3).
Plan invariant: A plan of a project with no declared fast gate is refused.
Plan invariant: A task is replanned at most once.
Port IdeasCommands (driving) via CommandChannelHandler and ReconcilePassDriver: one operation per use case; called by the command channel (horch idea ..., and the answers of a
sub-orchestrator to worker questions), the reconcile pass and the idea-folder ingester.
Port IdeasQueries (driving): read models IdeaBoard, InterviewRecord, InFlightDiffs, ApprovedAssumptionsAndSpec.
Port IdeasEventHandlers (driving) via InProcessReconcileConsumer: policies on feature-opened, replan-requested, task-branch-landed, feature-merged, task-escalated (onto the needs-you list)
and agent-status-changed (sub-orchestrator pane state).
Port IdeaFolderIngest (driving) via IdeaFolderIngester: assumptions.md, spec.md, requirements.yaml, plan.yaml, question and answer files; 1 ingestion per (path, sha256).
Port IdeasStore (driven) via SqliteIdeasStore: active-record rows of idea intake and questions: ideas, requirements, questions and sub-orchestrator attempt rows (task_id null).
Port EventPublisher (driven) via LedgerEventLog: writes the event row in the same ledger transaction.
Port LaunchEnvironmentGateway (driven) via InProcessWorkerProfiles: asks worker-profiles for the idea-lead launch environment.
Port AgentProcessGateway (driven) via InProcessWorkerProfiles: sends start-agent-process to worker-profiles to start or stop the sub-orchestrator pane; never inside a ledger transaction.
Port NeedsYouInbox (driven) via NeedsYouFolder: the 1 needs-you list (OR-3): approval requests, parked ideas, escalated questions and escalated tasks; herdr notification.
Port AttemptContext (driven) via EnvAttemptContext: tells whether the caller runs inside a fleet attempt, so approve and --direct refuse there.
Port Clock (driven) via PlatformAwakeClock: 30 min idle stop, 7 day park, question time limit, hourly reminder.
Port PlanRepository (driven) via SqlitePlanRepository: load and save Plan with its PlannedTasks by idea id and content hash.
Port IdeaFolderWriter (driven) via FsIdeaFolderWriter (ProtectedFiles of fleet-runtime): writes plan.verdict.json (plan-verdict-written) and approval.json (assumptions-approved) into the idea
folder, atomic; fleetd is their only writer.
